phase: Phase P4+ - Trip Logger Frontend Testing
summary: HUNTIQ V3 Trip Logger frontend fully tested. All features working: page navigation, trip creation modal, tabs (Active/History/Statistics), trip start/end workflow, observation logging. Fixed backend bug in /api/v1/trips/list endpoint that was failing due to old schema data. All 27 backend tests passed (100%).

features_tested.notes: Sorties link in navigation correctly navigates to /trips page
Page loads with 4 quick stat cards: Sorties totales, Taux de succès, Heures totales, Observations
Modal has: Titre (optional), Espèce ciblée (select), Date prévue (calendar), Notes (textarea). Trip creation works correctly.
Shows active trip panel when trip in progress, or 'Aucune sortie en cours' message with create button
Shows Sorties planifiées (with Démarrer buttons) and Historique (completed trips)
Shows TripStatsDashboard with stats cards, charts (Répartition par espèce, Activité mensuelle), and insights
StartTripModal with weather select and temperature input. Trip starts correctly with success toast.
Shows trip info, weather, timer, stats (Observations, Waypoints, Heures), and action buttons
AddObservationModal with type, species, count, distance, behavior, notes. Observation added correctly.
EndTripModal with trip summary, success checkbox, notes. Trip ends correctly with stats update.
Creates trip with title, target_species, planned_date, notes
Fixed bug - was failing due to old schema data. Added filter for trip_id exists.
Returns comprehensive stats: total_trips, success_rate, total_hours, by_species, by_weather
Returns active trip or {active: false, trip: null}
Ends trip, calculates duration, syncs to analytics
Logs observations with type, species, count, distance, behavior

fixed.issue: Was returning 400 'Statut invalide' due to old schema data without trip_id field
fixed.fix: Added filter {'trip_id': {'$exists': True}} to only query new schema trips

critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Frontend correctly handles loading states with Loader2 spinner
Toast notifications provide good user feedback (success/error)
Statistics dashboard gracefully handles empty data with 'Aucune donnée disponible' message
Trip workflow (create -> start -> observe -> end) is complete and functional
seed_data_creation: Test trips created during UI testing: 'Test Sortie Automatisée' with deer observation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trip Logger frontend fully tested. All CRUD operations, tabs, modals, and workflows working. Fixed /api/v1/trips/list endpoint to filter old schema data. Test user: test@huntiq.ca / password123. No authentication required for trip operations (fallback user enabled).
